en: Multi-view color postcard showing exterior and interior views of a domed former mosque, now a church. The main exterior image depicts a large stone building with an Ottoman-style green dome situated on a public square with gardens and a monument in front, against a hilly backdrop. The interior views show the Christianized mosque with an altar, crucifix, pews, arched windows with circular lattice openings, and striped arches in red and white. The reverse side has printed multilingual captions identifying the site and standard postcard layout for address and postage.
